tools.name: btc_price
tools.description: Get current Bitcoin (BTC) price in USD or specified currency. Returns real-time price data from cryptocurrency exchanges.

tools.name: eth_price
tools.description: Get current Ethereum (ETH) price in USD or specified currency. Returns real-time price data from cryptocurrency exchanges.

tools.name: market_data
tools.description: Get cryptocurrency market data including top coins by market cap. Returns data for the largest cryptocurrencies by market capitalization.

limit.description: Number of coins to return (default: 10, max: 100)

tools.name: trending_coins
tools.description: Get trending cryptocurrency coins. Returns coins that are currently trending based on social media activity and search volume.

limit.description: Number of trending coins to return (default: 10)

tools.name: coin_price
tools.description: Get price for any supported cryptocurrency symbol. Flexible tool to look up price data for any coin by its ticker symbol.

symbol.description: Coin symbol (e.g., BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE)

tools.name: api_status
tools.description: Check the x402 API service status and payment requirements. Returns service health and information about x402 payment protocol.

prompts.name: crypto_analysis
prompts.description: Get a quick analysis of cryptocurrency market conditions
